explanation: Gregor Mendel used the garden pea (Pisum sativum) to study patterns of inheritance, which required understanding its reproductive anatomy for controlled self-pollination and manual cross-pollination.

questions.q: Which plant's reproductive anatomy did Gregor Mendel study and manipulate in his genetics experiments?
questions.exp: Option B is correct because Mendel's breeding experiments were conducted using the garden pea, Pisum sativum.
